data.body: Landed: Gerrit 3424 merged as 9bef6894937 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, Linux ubuntu cells green, i.e. the case-sensitive filesystem). Portability: case-only git rename (two-step through a temp name), string-compare test, workflow edit in a Linux-only job; Windows sweep dispatched as test.yml run 44390588952 on 9bef6894937.
